limitations: Only the five inspected ecoinvent 3.8 cut-off PE open-dump cases calibrate; other polymers, versions, system models and fates are not inferred.
All climate classes remain separate, including upward leachate/evaporite behavior for negative infiltration; no climate collapse to wet dumping or controlled incineration.
Numerical calculation is independent; metadata functions requiring VBA are not used. Flow identity comes from public master-data UUIDs and existing exact canonical synonym evidence.
Runtime conversion does not depend on LibreOffice or these source workbooks. The frozen calculated coefficients are intended as reviewable migration data.
